slides.title: The late bloomer.
slides.body: Silent for 19 minutes. Suddenly sprinting like there's prize money.

slides.title: The clock watcher.
slides.body: Checks the clock after every rep. It has moved four seconds.

slides.title: The mathematician.
slides.body: Working out if three more reps beats their score from March. Mid-rep.

slides.title: The early finisher.
slides.body: Puts the bar down at 0:08, just to be safe. Starts tidying the plates.

slides.title: The buzzer beater.
slides.body: Starts a rep at 0:01. Insists it counts. Has a witness.

slides.title: The hype crew.
slides.body: Finished already. Now screaming your name from two metres away.
